description: This file defines a React functional component for managing tags, including listing, creating, editing, viewing details, and deleting tags. It interacts with backend APIs to fetch models and tags, and includes UI elements such as modals, buttons, and notifications.

methods.name: fetchTags
methods.description: Fetches the list of tags from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers re-fetching the tags and updates the last refreshed timestamp.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new tag via API call, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a tag by setting the tag to delete and showing the confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Performs the API call to delete the tag and refreshes the tag list.
